thread:
Alex H: FYI we just received a DSAR asking for full deletion of all user X's derived embeddings and any model-query logs. They specifically asked for confirmation that keys were not exported.
Maria P: @Beth (Legal) can you confirm required proof level? do we need signed attestation or a log export is enough?
Beth (Legal): Log export + a short attestation is fine. Need proof of deletion across all stores and KMS access audit showing no external key usage. Timestamp range: 2022-01-01 -> present.
Alex H: OK. two technical asks: 1) can we extract KMS key access events for that principal across regions? 2) confirm RBAC changes to allow a short-lived deleter role so ops can run the purge without broad perms.
Ben S: I can run the KMS query but need the exact key ids + principal. Alex, can you paste the user id and any vector DB shard ids?
Alex H: user_id: U-14237
Alex H: Shards: vec-prod-1, vec-prod-3 (there are snapshots in s3://redwood-prod-vec-snapshots/2024/*)
Ben S: running quick query now. using: ```aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01``` will take a few mins to collect.
Rob SRE: Heads-up: deleting embeddings is more than removing rows — we need to invalidate prefix/KV caches and remove any cached snapshots. Also consider search index replicas. We should do a canary delete on vec-prod-3 first.
Maria P: Agree. Also for audit purposes we should record the exact purge job id and the short-lived role ARN used to run it.
Alex H: Proposal: create role `dsar-purger` with zero standing rights, allow assume-role for 1h, scoped to deletion APIs + s3 delete on the snapshot path. Any objections?
Beth (Legal): Sounds good. Keep the assume-role window minimal and attach an audit hook (push to legal slack channel) when assumed.
Rob SRE: Fine. I'll prepare an infra PR to create the role and the policy. Need an SRE owner to run the canary and produce the logs.
Ben S: KMS query finished. audit-bot: summary attached.
Ben S: audit-bot: export file saved at s3://redwood-audit-exports/1742509876-kms-events.json.gz
audit-bot: Found 0 KeyUsage events with external principal usage. 12 ConsoleDecrypt calls by internal service/vec-ingest. No cross-account Decrypt events in that time window.
Alex H: Good. That helps. Next: retention exception question — user claims they deleted account in 2023 but we have snapshots from before that date. Legal: do we need to remove historical snapshots that contain the embedding derivation?
Beth (Legal): If data is identifiable to the user and deletion request covers those copies, yes. We need to map which snapshots contain the user's vectors. If we can't deterministically remove from older aggregated snapshots, we must document the attempt and provide attestation of best-effort deletion.
Maria P: Action items: 1) Ben to tag snapshots that contain user vectors (query by vector id). 2) Rob to prepare canary purge plan + role PR. 3) Alex to prepare attestation template for Legal.
Alex H: I'll draft attestation. Ben — ETA on snapshot tagging?
Ben S: ETA ~2h to run vector search across snapshots and emit a manifest s3://redwood-privacy-manifests/1742509876-manifest.json
Rob SRE: I'll open the infra PR now and include an assume-role webhook to post to #privacy-requests when assumed. Also will include CloudTrail filter to collect assume-role events.
Maria P: Small vuln triage note — there was a recently flagged issue where assume-role tokens were logged to CloudWatch by a flaky Lambda. We should avoid including sensitive tokens in logs. Can we make sure the purge job runtime doesn't print creds?
Rob SRE: Good catch. I'll ensure the job only logs job-id, actor, and affected shards. No environmental dumps.
Beth (Legal): Once we have manifest + purge logs + KMS audit export, we can sign the attestation. Include the canary job output and deletion job ids.
Alex H: Thanks everyone. I'll update the DSAR tracker and ping the requestor when we have the signed attestation.
Ben S: Manifest uploaded: s3://redwood-privacy-manifests/1742509876-manifest.json
audit-bot: Purge role created in infra branch: refs/heads/priv/dsar-purger. Assume-role events will show up in CloudTrail under EventName=AssumeRole.
Rob SRE: Canary purge ran on vec-prod-3, job id purge-1742509950. No errors, 42 vectors removed. Logs: s3://redwood-privacy-logs/purge-1742509950.log
Alex H: Perfect. Once we run the full purge we should snapshot the final manifest and store it with the attestation.
Beth (Legal): Approved for proceed once full manifest and PR are merged. Keep assume-role window at 1 hour and rotate key if any anomalies. :white_check_mark:
Alex H: Proceeding. I'll post final update when done.
